title: Elon Musk is steamrolling Wall Street to become a trillionaire
brief: Elon Musk filed to take SpaceX public in a $2 trillion IPO while X (formerly Twitter), buried in the S-1 filing, shows stagnation across user growth and revenue metrics. Despite the promised "everything app" and billion-user vision never materializing, Musk's net worth has nearly tripled since buying Twitter in 2022, and he's bent corporate governance rules to enable the offering.
